label: OBSERVED
source: Binance web UI: Profile > Dashboard > Sub-account > Account Management > View permissions

metadata.observation: The operator inspected the View permissions screen for the Agentic sub-account and reported that no permission can be toggled on or off there. The screen lists permissions; it does not edit them.
metadata.evidence_type: operator observation of a web interface
metadata.resolves: Part 0.4 contradiction 1: MCP documentation says disconnect and reconnect to update permissions; launch material says permissions are reviewable or changeable under Account Management. The observation supports the MCP documentation.
metadata.consequence: Narrowing an over-broad grant is not an edit. It requires disconnecting the agent and re-authorizing from scratch, which is the documented remediation cost for the least-privilege diff.
